summary: Polygon's guide to everything arriving on Netflix in November 2023, organized by release date. Highlights include adult animation (Scott Pilgrim Takes Off, Blue Eye Samurai), the Squid Game reality show, and The Crown's Season 6 Part 1. The editor's pick is The Social Network, praised for its Eisenberg and Garfield performances and its autumnal Harvard look.
one_line: Polygon's date-by-date guide to Netflix's November 2023 additions, with The Social Network as the editor's pick.
key_facts: Polygon's editor's pick for November 2023 is The Social Network, available on Netflix Nov. 1.
Petrana Radulovic's pick praises Jesse Eisenberg and Andrew Garfield for their performances and chemistry, and the autumnal shots of Harvard and the Winklevoss twins rowing.
A popular fan theory holds that the romantic comedy Red, White, and Royal Blue started as fanfic of The Social Network.
Blue Eye Samurai arrives Nov. 3, and Scott Pilgrim Takes Off arrives Nov. 17, making November a strong month for adult animation.
The Crown: Season 6 Part 1 arrives Nov. 16, with Queen Elizabeth II reflecting on her legacy as Diana dazzles the public in the final weeks of her life.
Squid Game: The Challenge arrives Nov. 22 with new episodes weekly through December 6; 456 real players compete for USD $4.56 million.

The Netflix Cup: Swing to Survive streams live Nov. 14 at 3p.m. PT / 6p.m. ET from Wynn Golf Club at Wynn Las Vegas, Netflix's first-ever live sports event, pairing Formula 1 drivers with PGA TOUR pros.
The Killer, an assassin film, arrives Nov. 10.
NYAD, the true story of Diana Nyad's 110-mile open ocean swim from Cuba to Florida at age 60, arrives Nov. 3.
Leo, an Adam Sandler musical comedy where he voices a class pet lizard, arrives Nov. 21.
Family Switch, directed by McG and starring Jennifer Garner, Ed Helms, Emma Myers and Brady Noon, arrives Nov. 30.
Obliterated, an action-comedy series from the creators of Cobra Kai, and Virgin River: Season 5 Part 2 also arrive Nov. 30.
All the Light We Cannot See, directed by Shawn Levy and based on Anthony Doerr's Pulitzer Prize-winning novel, arrives Nov. 2.
Netflix Games titles Slayaway Camp 2: Netflix & Kill and Dead Cells: Netflix Edition are available in November.
